_defects.module: SA-01 · Sign in and two-step verification
_defects.description: An admin link opened from outside the admin (email, chat, browser extension) bounced a signed-in person to the sign-in page, which then sent them to the dashboard instead of the page they asked for.
_defects.steps: 1. Sign in as super admin. 2. Open http://localhost:3000/admin/collections/tenants from outside the admin (a link in another site or the extension's navigate). 3. Watch where you land.
_defects.expected: All vendors opens (signing in first only when actually signed out).
_defects.actual: Payload ignores the session cookie on cross-site navigations (CSRF rule), redirects to /admin/login?redirect=…; our sign-in page saw the person was signed in and redirected to /admin, dropping the redirect.
_defects.remarks: Fixed: SignInView now redirects a signed-in visitor to the requested /admin path (safeRedirect, unit tested; outside paths and the sign-in page fall back to the dashboard). Retested in Chrome: lands on the vendor page.

_defects.module: SA-05 · Vendor overview and store status
_defects.description: Plan usage always showed "Orders this month 0": nothing updated the tenant's ordersThisMonth counter, so the meter and the 90% limit warning never moved.
_defects.steps: 1. Have orders this month for Home Orbit (pnpm demo:orders home-orbit or a storefront order). 2. Open All vendors → Home Orbit → Plan usage.
_defects.expected: Orders this month counts the orders placed this month.
_defects.actual: 0 / 1,000 while the dashboard showed 8 sold orders and 18 placed this month.
_defects.remarks: Fixed: counted from the orders (reports ordersThisMonth / ordersPlacedByStore) on the vendor overview, the store's plan card and the dashboard's limit warnings. Retested: 18 / 1,000. Open question for the product: the monthly order limit is shown but never enforced at checkout.
